summary: Extend the paired baseline with ~8 frontier l1-v3 spans on a sayings/logia work
description:
The free paired set is Iamblichus-heavy (22 of 36 spans) and contains NO sayings collection. l1-v3 states the source-order rule is 'especially binding for sayings collections and logia, where source order is the structure' — precisely the genre where a smaller model is most likely to reorder thematically. Benchmarking without it flatters the local model on its weakest axis.

Pick a logia work already in the corpus (gospel-of-thomas, or the bhagavad-gita chapters) and generate ~8 L1 spans under the FRONTIER provider at prompt_version l1-v3, so the local arm has a same-template counterpart to be judged against.

This is the only step that deliberately spends frontier calls. Gated on the previous ticket: do not spend them until span identity is proven.

DONE: ~8 accepted frontier l1-v3 rows exist for the chosen logia work in the snapshot DB, and the work + span ids are recorded on this ticket.

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content:
Candidate analysis (no GPU used). Corpus: 64 works / 23 traditions; span counts min 1, median 5, p75 17, max 74. The EXISTING paired set sits at 3934-5664 tok/span (iamblichus 5169, egyptian-heaven-and-hell 5664, apocryphon-of-john 3934) — i.e. long continuous prose. The missing axis is therefore DISCRETE-UNIT ORDERING, not just 'a sayings work'.

Scale-matched logia (~4800-5300 tok/span, STABLE, no orphans): pythagorean-golden-verses (greek_mystery, 15 spans, 5260), orphic-hymns (greek_mystery, 13 spans, 4841), yoga-sutras books 01-04 (hinduism, 7 spans composite, ~4900).
Genre-purest but ~1500 tok/span: dhammapada (buddhism, 26 spans, 1541), bhagavad-gita (hinduism, 18 spans, 1496), gathas (zoroastrianism, 17 spans, 1486).
DISQUALIFIED: zhuangzi-inner-chapters-index (9 of 18 accepted rows orphaned — span layout drifted); gospel-of-thomas (purest logia but only 2 spans).

Separate finding: 16 of 51 works with accepted L1 rows have rows that match no c8 planned span (secret-teachings 70/72, pistis-sophia 34/34, transcendental-magic 29/29, mabinogion 26/30, iamblichus 16/38). For iamblichus the orphans are its older l1-v2 rows — its 22 l1-v3 rows all matched, which is why the gate passed. Per AGENTS.md these are not to be deleted.

resolution.note: Dhammapada, 8 chapters (~1540 tok/span discrete verses), 7 paired. First run under the pinned sampler so it is reproducible. GENERATION: frontier 8/8 in 8 calls with 0 retries; local 7/8 in ~18 calls with every span retried and +40.6% length; 3 spans across ch1-18 exhausted MAX_ATTEMPTS and produced nothing. Cause is the budget formula min(300,max(80,tok//12)) — an 87-token budget for a 1052-token chapter vs 300 for Iamblichus — not the genre. REVIEW: opus 14/14 accept, qwen 5/14, agreement 36% (vs 87.9% on long prose). Which judge is right is NOT established. One COVERAGE reject fired, the only one in the study, from qwen on a row opus accepted. Findings: docs/dossiers/c8-dhammapada-logia.md
